revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction and one schema mislabel needs fixing; overall analysis is otherwise well-grounded. Fixes: (1) In multi_touch_patterns[0].touches[0], the quote 'Is can it a cheaper solar payment...' is misattributed to 02:56 -- the actual line occurs at 03:13-03:23; the rep's 'Exactly. That's correct.' response occurs at 03:23, not immediately after 02:56. Correct the timestamp. (2) In script_coverage, the entry labeled 'tax_credit_qualifier' at ts 02:42 actually documents the credit_qualifier (670 credit score threshold), not the tax credit disclosure note -- relabel this entry to 'credit_qualifier' and optionally cross-check against the schema's known credit-threshold drift issue (SESSION18_fcbf33c1 stated 650) since this rep correctly stated 670. (3) In cherry_pick_moments[3], the classification field says 'setter_scope_creep' but the stewart_read explicitly says this is 'actually correct scope discipline, not creep' -- align the classification label with the corrected read to avoid contradicting itself. (4) Consider adding a cherry_pick_moment or note for the 01:18-01:58 exchange where the rep guesses at tree/shading orientation (west side, then has to be corrected on left/right) -- this is a live example of rep improvising uncertain technical detail that fits the knowledge_gap_handling directive and was otherwise omitted despite a similar (smaller) moment at 08:05 being flagged. These are targeted fixes; the trajectory read, bill-anchor audit, handoff brief, and outcome classification are all well-supported and should be preserved as-is.
